text:
rachel_pm: Heads-upwe need a concise safe-upgrade plan for Private (VPC/on-prem). Goal: lock approach by EOW.
kevin_eng: Suggest minimal default path: single-installer for 90% customers + opt-in modular mode (control-plane/data-plane/connector).
sarah_pd: Customers consistently ask for: maintenance window flag, non-disruptive rollback, and ability to pin model/runtime versions.
jordan_netops: Networking reality: many customers require predictable egress IPs. We should publish three modes: static-egress, vpc-peering, and proxy-forwarding. Each has different firewall expectations.
leo_ops: Operational safety: pre-upgrade snapshot (KV + config), progressive canary (5%->25%->100%), and auto-revert on failing smoke tests. Need snapshot <30s target for small installs.
maya_support: Add a single diag-bundle command pre/post-upgrade and a human-in-loop abort switch. Support needs these to reduce triage time.
kevin_eng: Implementation notes: packages signed; semver for packages and model bundles; migration manifest for hooks. Example doc string for docs: {"migration_version":"1.0","pre_hooks":["snapshot_kv","pause_ingress"],"post_hooks":["smoke_infer","reconcile_routes"]} (we'll include in spec).
sarah_pd: Minimum launch checklist: installer (--maintenance), auto snapshot+revert script, network quickstart per mode with firewall samples, smoke tests (infer/auth/telemetry), runbook + diag docs, & pilot with 3-4 customers.
jordan_netops: For static-egress include steps to pre-allocate IPs and preserve them across node cycling; provide NAT gateway option and example iptables rules.
leo_ops: Rollback SLA: if revert >5m, page on-call. Targets: config revert <60s, KV restore <2m (small deployment).achel_pm: Action items: kevin -> draft migration manifest + package split spec; leo -> prototype snapshot/revert + diag bundle; jordan -> network quickstart + firewall reconcile script; sarah -> pilot list + success criteria.
kevin_eng: I'll open PR for schema/spec by Tue EOD.
sarah_pd: I'll start compliance outreach and pilot coordination.
leo_ops: Will spin a staging demo this sprint.
maya_support: I'll prepare support checklist and triage playbook.
rachel_pm: Great. Checkpoint Thu AM 30m. Ping here if anything blocks the PR or prototypes. :thumbsup:
